title: Pool Robot Dock Communication Loss
app: Flo by Moen, Rachio, Flume, Maytronics Dolphin, pool sensors, water softener sensors, and irrigation controllers via vendor APIs, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=maytronics:robot event=dock
| stats count(eval(status="offline")) as dock_offline_events by robot
| where dock_offline_events>0
| sort - dock_offline_events
description: Uses Maytronics dock telemetry telemetry to monitor dock communication loss for the pool robot in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for charging or connectivity issues that leave the robot unavailable, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Maytronics dock telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Robot table of dock offline events.
grandmaExplanation: It frames dock communication loss for the pool robot so you can spot charging or connectivity issues that leave the robot unavailable before it becomes annoying.
